name: kafka
description: kafka is distributed, durable, partioned and append only log event. - Distributed : Data and workloads can be spread across mutiple brokers. - Durable : Records can be persisted and replicated to survive failures. - Partitioned : Topic are divided into independent order logs - Append only : New records are appended rather than modifying earlier logs  - Event log : Consumers track their own positions through the records.
